widget.doc: A drawn illustration, colored by the theme: role is hero (a person mid-jump under the rope), streak (a flame), empty (a rope at rest), record (a medal) or cheer (arms up, for a finished session); audience is adult or kid; size it with w and h.

props.doc: What the drawing is for: hero (a person mid-jump under the rope), streak (a flame), empty (a rope at rest), record (a medal), cheer (the jumper with both arms up, for a finished session).
Who the drawing is for: adult (lean, calm) or kid (rounder, playful, with confetti).
